purpose: Teach: ことわざ/虫歯/ふんだんに/かぶり/豆乳/もてる/そういや/覗く

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お祖父ちゃんから、ことわざ、本気で、教えてもらったよ、ぼく、覚えたよ、絶対、嬉しい、本気で。
lines.en: Mom, Grandpa really taught me a proverb, and I memorized it. I'm so happy about it, seriously.
lines.style: Bright burst of pride. Quick cadence, each phrase tumbling over the next. Voice high and warm. Slight breathlessness from excitement. Leans in toward mom.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。虫歯、できないように、本気で、歯磨き、しっかり、するのよ、翔くん、約束、絶対、ね。
lines.en: Mm-hmm. And you'll brush your teeth really carefully so you don't get cavities, okay Sho? You promised me absolutely.
lines.style: Gentle but firm instruction. Warm undertone. Steady pace, not rushed. Slight emphasis on 「約束」 like she's naming something sacred between them. Touches his shoulder or hair.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お祖母ちゃんの料理、ふんだんに、本気で、お野菜、入ってて、美味しいんだよね、ママ、絶対。
lines.en: And Grandma's cooking is so good because she puts so much—so many vegetables in it, right Mom? So many.
lines.style: Stream-of-consciousness warmth. Slightly scattered pace, wandering through the memory. Eyes bright. Soft smile in the voice. Small pause before 「美味しいんだよね」 like he's savoring the thought.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 帽子、本気で、かぶり、外、暑いから、絶対、忘れないでね、翔くん、約束、本気で、絶対、ね。
lines.en: And you'll wear your hat outside because it's hot, okay? Don't forget, Sho. That's a promise. Really.
lines.style: Calm, maternal directive. Even pace, no urgency. Warm firmness. The tone of someone who will repeat this again tomorrow and the day after without frustration.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 豆乳、本気で、ぼく、最近、好きになってきたんだ、ママ、健康に、本気で、いいよね、絶対、絶対。
lines.en: Soy milk, actually. I've started really liking it lately, Mom. It's so good for you, isn't it? Really good.
lines.style: Genuine discovery in his voice. Quieter than his first line, more reflective. Small emphasis on the newness of liking something. Sounds like he's learning himself as he speaks.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、若い頃、もてる人だったって、お祖母ちゃんから、聞いたわよ、翔くん、本当に、絶対、本気で。
lines.en: Your dad was actually really popular when he was young—that's what Grandma told me. He really was, Sho. Seriously.
lines.style: Wistful, almost amused recollection. Softer register than her directive lines. Slight smile. Pace slows like she's remembering. Ends with gentle certainty, like she's sharing a small family secret.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: そういや、ママ、お母さんの日、絶対、近いよね、ぼく、本気で、お祝い、絶対、考えてるんだ、本気で、約束、絶対。
lines.en: Oh, and Mom's Day is coming up soon, isn't it? I'm really thinking about how to celebrate you, Mom. I promise. Really.
lines.style: Tender realization dawning mid-thought. Pace slows on 「お祝い」. Slightly shy, but earnest underneath. Small voice that grows more certain. The voice of a child offering something precious.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 窓から、本気で、外の景色、覗くと、絶対、お祭りの提灯、見えるわよね、翔くん、楽しみね、本気で、絶対、本気で。
lines.en: If you peek out the window, you can see the festival lanterns outside. You can see them, can't you Sho? That'll be fun. So much fun.
lines.style: Inviting and soft. Opens the window of possibility in her voice. Warm cadence, almost musical. Slight trailing-off with wonder, like she's seeing it fresh through his eyes. The intimacy of sharing something small and lovely.
